opportunities.name: NPS park info lookup by state
opportunities.description: Find a National Park Service park by choosing a US state from the 'Find a Park by State' list, then open one section of that state's park or heritage-area page (e.g. Current Conditions, Basic Information).
steps: Click the 'Find a Park by State' button.
Click the link for the target state (e.g. Alaska, Florida, California).
Click the target park or section link on the state page (e.g. 'Current Conditions »', '1 National Heritage Area »', 'Basic Information »').
Read or extract the information on the resulting page.
parameters: park or section link to open (Current Conditions, Basic Information, National Heritage Area, etc.)

instances.values: state=Alaska; no section opened before the next state search
state=Florida; sections=Current Conditions, then 1 National Heritage Area. The Kenai Mountains-Turnagain Arm click at t=32.7 is excluded because it looks like an Alaska link, so it is ambiguous

opportunities.name: Megabus bus tracking by service number
opportunities.description: Track a Megabus bus by entering its service number on the 'Track my bus' page, optionally choosing a stop or city, then running the search.
steps: Click 'Check my bus'.
Click 'Track my bus'.
Click the 'Service Number' tab.
Type the service number into the 'Search by Service Number' box.
If the service needs a location, select the city or stop from the dropdown.
Click 'Find my bus' (or submit the search).

instances.values: service_number=SE4; location=Columbia, SC; submitted with 'Find my bus'. Unrelated rei.com actions sit between the two segments

opportunities.name: Resy event ticket booking
opportunities.description: Find a Resy special event or venue listing, choose the number of tickets (and a time slot if offered), then reserve or book it.
steps: Open the Special Events & Experiences listing or search for the event or venue.
Click the target event or venue card.
Set the ticket or party-size dropdown to the desired quantity.
Select a time slot if one is offered.
Click 'Book Now' or 'Reserve Now' and continue through any next or checkout steps.

instances.values: event=Thursday, May 4th American Express Presents CARB...; tickets=3; ticket type=Centurion Member Access. The Reserve Now/NEXT clicks at 513.9–520.0 are probably the continuation, but this is uncertain
event=HAPPY HOUR BURGER, Aria, Thursday April 13 2023; tickets=1; time slot=5:00 PM; then Reserve Now at 645.6. Unrelated rei.com actions sit between 612.5 and 645.6

opportunities.name: Amazon book search and list add
opportunities.description: Search Amazon for a book or Kindle title, filter or sort the results, open a title, and add it to a list.
steps: Open the menu and go to Kindle Books (or use the search box).
Type the search terms into 'Search Amazon' and click 'Go'.
Apply filters such as language (English) or sort by Publication Date (under 'Featured').
Click the target book.
Click 'Add to List' and then 'Submit'.
parameters: filters or sort order (e.g. English, Publication Date)
book title to add to list

instances.values: search='roman empire history'; navigated to Kindle eBooks and filtered to English
sort=Publication Date; book='Records of the Medieval Sword'; added to a list via 'Add to List' then 'Submit'
